# Bitcoin Roatán

> Roatán, the most bitcoin island in the world. An interactive map of 90+ places on Roatán, Honduras that accept Bitcoin (mostly Lightning), plus upcoming local Bitcoin events. English only.

## Pages

- [Home](https://bitcoinroatan.info/): Landing page with the island map, merchant search by category, and upcoming events (single-page site).

## Data and code

- Merchant data comes from BTCMap (https://btcmap.org/map), a community map built on OpenStreetMap.
- Source code (MIT): https://github.com/itstomekk/bitcoin-roatan
